defects.title: create_transport_request and add_objects_to_transport had no pre-change observation branch
defects.observed: SAP pre-change observation could not establish whether ... exists: source: observation failed; the write was never dispatched (sapInvocationStarted false) for both tools
defects.cause: neither tool had a branch in src/write-prechange-evidence.ts, so the generic ADT source observation threw 'write target has no readable source identity'
defects.correction: added observeTransportRequestCreate (listUserTransports) and observeTransportObjectAdd (transportDetails + transportEntries) plus unit coverage

defects.title: add_objects_to_transport raised a DBIF_RSQL_INVALID_RSQL short dump after the entry had already been recorded
defects.observed: HTTP 500 RABAX_STATE, DBIF_RSQL_INVALID_RSQL at LZORVANTA_MCP_COREU03 line 5956, CX_SY_OPEN_SQL_DB; the tool reported failure although E071 already held the entry
defects.cause: SELECT trkorr pgmid object obj_name FROM e071 INTO TABLE lt_d9_add_e071 where lt_d9_add_e071 was STANDARD TABLE OF e071; the positional target starts with MANDT (CLNT 3), so trkorr (CHAR 20) was written into a client field
defects.correction: declared a flat type ty_d9_add_e071 holding exactly the four selected columns as e071 table-field references and used it for the work area and the table
defects.evidence: three dumps at 20260924102123/24/25 before the fix; A1 now returns a completed result with no new dump

defects.title: cleanup_transport_entries does not remove the entry it reports as removed
defects.observed: CTS_CLEANUP_POSTCHECK_ENTRY_REMAINS and the entry is still present in E071
defects.cause: the objects were listed directly under tm:request, but the entry belongs to the task container: SAP answered the PUT with 2xx and resolved tm:abap_object against the request, which does not hold a task's entry. The HTTP status could not have revealed this, because the ADT client already rejects 4xx and 5xx
defects.impact: CTS entries cannot be cleaned up through this tool, so a mistakenly recorded object cannot be undone through the MCP surface
defects.evidence: .doc/d9-acceptance-20260924.log and the targeted cleanup call recorded above
defects.fix: buildTransportCleanupRequest now nests tm:abap_object inside tm:task when the task differs from the request; src/adt-backend.ts, covered by test/transport-delivery.test.ts
defects.fixVerification: tested on 2026-09-24 against w200 after a service restart (artifactFingerprint 4bab5f8a53be9d8526a9be96150d35394ffd8a8a52209468418b5dd861831d39): the PUT still returned 2xx and the entry R3TR TABL ZORV_MCP_T01 position 000024 was still present in E071, so CTS_CLEANUP_POSTCHECK_ENTRY_REMAINS was raised again. The nesting change is therefore NOT proven to work
defects.conclusion: platform limitation rather than an open code defect: the native ADT removeobject action is absent from the bundled abap-adt-api client (no independent evidence it exists), src/capabilities.ts already reports this tool's availability as unknown because it requires successful native ADT removeobject support, docs/tool-compatibility-matrix.md already records the endpoint as unverified on ECC 7.31, and two structurally different payload shapes both returned 2xx while removing nothing. The tool fails safely: its own post-check refuses to report success, so no caller can be misled. The practical remedy is to remove the entry in SE09/SE10

defects.title: add_objects_to_transport reports success while the object is recorded in a different container
defects.observed: requested GR2K923488, SAP returned requestNumber GR2K923486 / taskNumber GR2K923487 with insertedCount 1
defects.cause: TRINT_OBJECTS_CHECK_AND_INSERT refuses to record an object that already belongs to another open transport and returns that order/task; the tool relays SAP's numbers but does not flag that they differ from the request
defects.impact: a caller reading only status/insertedCount believes the object is in the requested request when it is not

defects.title: get_user_transports does not list a request that was just created for that user
defects.observed: 0 transport requests for user WYS immediately after creating GR2K923488, while the helper's retry guard matched it

defects.title: E07T is not in the D5-2 read allowlist
defects.observed: TABLE_NOT_ALLOWED for E07T, so a CTS request description cannot be read back through read_abap_table

defects.title: the create observation can under-report an existing request
defects.observed: observeTransportRequestCreate derives existence from listUserTransports, which per D-5 does not surface the request
defects.impact: on a retry the pre-change evidence may claim exists=false although an identical request exists
defects.evidence: code path in src/write-prechange-evidence.ts combined with V2

safety.note: GR2K923472 and GR2K923473 were never released. One entry was accidentally recorded into task GR2K923473 (defect D-3 blocks its removal) and is reported for manual removal.
